name: A turn of a few minutes gets a face but leaves the mood alone
case: Two turns of a few minutes each finish well, one with passing tests. Each finish gets a pleased face, held once or twice, but no cheer, since neither stands out. Boop's mood stays happy.
why: plan/steering/mood/happy.md: happy stays through one or two routine finishes, even a few minutes long, since only a very long turn (5 minutes or more) finishing done makes it excited; PERSONALITY's Examples: a turn of a minute or more finishing gets a face, held once, and no cheer: only a finish that stands out cheers
